reason: A GitHub Gist integration that exports and imports DeepSeek Harness plugin manifests, updates local profile files, and automatically installs imported dependencies; publication warrants human review because it uses OAuth, remote storage, file writes, and package installation.

summaries.zh: 通过 GitHub Gist 在不同环境间导出和导入 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单，并更新配置及安装依赖。
summaries.en: Syncs DeepSeek Harness plugin manifests through GitHub Gists, updating local configuration and installing imported dependencies.

capabilities: GitHub OAuth device-flow authentication with gist permission
Creates private GitHub Gists when no destination is provided
Uploads and downloads plugin manifest data through GitHub Gists
Writes plugin dependencies and profile configuration files
Automatically runs pnpm install during import
